_meta.note: Story video (docs/VIDEO_STORYBOARD.md). 'at' = voice start in seconds. Section starts and musical hits sit on the 100 BPM bar grid (2.4 s), so the score and the cuts land together.
_meta.say: 'say' is what the voice reads when it differs from the caption: Qloo is pronounced "clue".

lines.text: Meet Maya, a folk singer planning her first five-city tour.
She's picking cities on gut feel, and every empty seat comes out of her pocket.
What if you could see where your fans already are?
Type an act and confirm it on Qloo. Here, with a real artist's Qloo data: Big Thief.
lines.say: Type an act and confirm it on Clue. Here, with a real artist's Clue data: Big Thief.

lines.text: Qloo's taste graph lights up where this audience actually concentrates, across the whole country.
lines.say: Clue's taste graph lights up where this audience actually concentrates, across the whole country.

lines.text: Each hotspot becomes a city, scored by the live rooms these fans favour. The top five make the cut.
Each stop: where fans cluster, real rooms they favour, and an opener whose fans share their taste.
Claude drafts the pitch to each booker, citing Qloo evidence.
lines.say: Claude drafts the pitch to each booker, citing Clue evidence.

lines.text: Ask the scout. An agent runs Qloo tools and proposes a change. Apply it, and the opener swaps.
lines.say: Ask the scout. An agent runs Clue tools and proposes a change. Apply it, and the opener swaps.

lines.text: No more guesswork. A live plan takes under a minute,
and every claim links to the exact Qloo request behind it.
lines.say: and every claim links to the exact Clue request behind it.

lines.text: Under the hood: Qloo's official harness finds and scores the cities, Claude Haiku writes, and the server checks every claim before you see it.
lines.say: Under the hood: Clue's official harness finds and scores the cities, Claude Haiku writes, and the server checks every claim before you see it.

lines.text: Tour Scout. Find your fans before you book the room.
